title: special-wepon
description: This Minecraft mod adds special weapons with custom abilities into the game while trying to keep the vanilla experience!
body:
This is a mod that adds special weapons to the game while still trying to be Vanilla friendly. It is very simple and only requires Fabric API and nothing else as per v1.0 there is only two sets Ivy and Blood. Each set has
- An Ingot/Material
- Mace
- Sword
- Axe
- A complete/incomplete armor set
Each except for the Armor have a special ability as well that can be activated by right clicking the wepon.

Thats all.Thanks and enjoy(I will add a Youtube video when I finish making the video)
